description: Approval requests routed by Power Automate (Phase 3). Polymorphic related-record reference until flows are built.

columns.name: fpip_related_record
columns.notes: Polymorphic: stores the related record's GUID + table name (e.g. 'p1|fpip_purchaseorders') until Power Automate is built.

notes: This is the table Phase-3 Power Automate flows act on (requisition / tender award / invoice exception / contract renewal approvals).
